title: Tiempos narrativos: had been doing, would y used to

rule.title: Narrative tenses: had been doing, would and used to
rule.explanation:
Para contar una historia con matices:
- past simple: los hechos principales: «I arrived in Bristol in September.»
- past continuous: la situación de fondo: «It was raining and everyone was rushing.»
- past perfect simple: acción terminada antes de otra: «I had never seen so much rain.»
- past perfect continuous («had been» + «-ing»): una actividad que duraba hasta un momento del pasado: «I had been studying English for months, but I couldn't understand the bus driver.»
- «would» + verbo: acciones repetidas en el pasado, típico de la narración nostálgica. Solo sirve para acciones, no para estados: «I would get lost every Saturday.»
- «used to» + verbo: hábitos y también estados del pasado: «I used to think 'craic' was a kind of bread.»

Más recursos narrativos:
- futuro en el pasado: «Little did I know this city would become my home.»
- «was / were about to»: «I was about to give up when I met Priya.»

Ojo: «would» no vale para estados («I would live in Madrid» con ese sentido está mal; «I used to live in Madrid»).

rows: I had never seen such rain.
I had been studying for months.
I would get lost every Saturday.
